fact: NEBE inaugurated the Mirchaye voter registration system on 5 January 2026, with voters registered by officers on Board tablets, by web self-registration or by mobile app at selected polling stations, and by manual registers at the remaining stations.
NEBE says web and mobile self-registration in the Mirchaye system uses Fayda (National ID) data.

The National Election Board introduced digital voter registration with tablets and the Mirchaye app from January 2026, falling back to paper where networks failed, and says nearly 5.5 million people obtained voter cards digitally.
NEBE chairperson Melatwork Hailu highlighted the integration of voter registration with the Fayda Digital ID system, to prevent duplication.
NEBE's chairperson said the digital application for voter enrolment was fully developed and operational, allowing remote registration.
